character.name: Mother Golden Test
character.prompt: Middle-aged Vietnamese mother NPC for a 2.5D isometric stroke awareness game. Warm modern 16-bit pixel art matching a cozy Vietnamese urban home. Wearing dark purple Vietnamese do bo pajamas with small pink floral patterns, simple sandals, black hair tied back with a claw clip. Kind tired face, readable middle-aged silhouette, clean black pixel outline, cohesive warm lofi colors, polished commercial game asset, transparent background, readable from all directions.
